Title: Replace hardcoded queue capacity nodeId=='A' with topology MaxConcurrentRequests
Description: Both Mcp/Program.cs and Dashboard/Program.cs have: queueFactory: nodeId => new NodeQueue(capacity: nodeId == 'A' ? 64 : 32). This silently gives all Worker and LlamaCpp nodes a capacity of 32 regardless of MaxConcurrentRequests in NodeConfiguration. Fix: use topologyConfig.Nodes.FirstOrDefault(n => n.NodeId == nodeId)?.MaxConcurrentRequests ?? 32.
